significance: A kavu on the Achankovil river at Kalleli, roughly 19 km from Pathanamthitta town, whose rites follow the usage of the early Dravida-Naga tribes rather than the tantric procedure of ordinary Kerala temples.
story: Appooppan is honoured as lord of the 999 Mala Daivangal, the mountain gods, with Oorali Ammoomma revered as his mother.
